item_text.B1: I believe God is loving, caring and active in my life, like a very good parent would be.
item_text.B2: I believe Jesus has provided a way for me to have a relationship with God forever.
item_text.B3: I believe that openly and honestly speaking to God is necessary for a healthy relationship with God.
item_text.B4: I believe God regularly communicates with me in ways I can recognize.
item_text.B5: I believe nothing can keep me from experiencing God's unconditional love -- even my own sin - if I turn to God.
item_text.B6: I believe the way God sees me is rooted in God's faithful love for me.
item_text.B7: I believe the challenging circumstances of my life will be used by God to deepen my trust in God's care for me.
item_text.B8: I believe loving others can make a difference in my relationship with God.
item_text.B9: I believe that God desires to be actively involved in all the relationships that are part of my life.
item_text.K1: I believe God originally created the world to be good.
item_text.K2: I believe human failures have caused our world to be broken, altering what God designed.
item_text.K3: I believe God will one day make everything new, as God intended it to be.
item_text.K4: I believe I can sometimes have experiences of God's promised future in my everyday life now.
item_text.K5: I believe I will not always experience God's healing in every circumstance of my life now.
item_text.K6: I see myself as an active partner with God in helping to restore God's desires to make the earth new again.
item_text.K7: I believe God's Holy Spirit can guide my actions to fulfill God's desires for this world in which we live.
item_text.K8: I believe loving others as Jesus has loved me is one of the most important things I can do to further God's will in this world.
item_text.K9: I believe serving the poor and oppressed is an essential part of God's plan to restore God's justice in the world.
item_text.A1: Following God has changed my behavior, affecting how I speak, the places I go, and the moral decisions I make.
item_text.A2: I seek to know how God wants me to use my gifts and abilities.
item_text.A3: I actively try to listen and understand everyone with whom I have a relationship.
item_text.A4: I work toward pursuing reconciliation in any broken relationships by both requesting and giving forgiveness.
item_text.A5: I gladly use my resources (home, money, time) to help others experience the love and invitation of Jesus.
item_text.A6: I meet together weekly with other Christians to worship/pray/learn.
item_text.A7: I have people I trust with whom I can be honest about the state of my spiritual life and walk.
item_text.A8: I have formed some close relationships through which I try to help people on their spiritual journey.
item_text.A9: I welcome the practical wisdom and input of other Christians in my journey to become more like Jesus.
item_text.L1: I show kindness and care for the needs of people just as they are, as God has done for me.
item_text.L2: I do not require that people change for me to forgive them.
item_text.L3: I work toward forgiving others who have wronged me just as God forgives me.
item_text.L4: I am gladly willing to give generously to people who are in need.
item_text.L5: I take notice of people who are not always accepted and form relationships with them.
item_text.L6: I take practical actions against oppression and injustice.
item_text.L7: I am willing to share about my life with God when talking with others.
item_text.L8: The Holy Spirit helps me apply God's wisdom to specific life situations that I see or experience.
item_text.L9: In the various settings of my life (e.g. work, home, with friends, etc.), people see in me God's love being expressed.
item_text.P1: I try to focus on seeing people around me through God's eyes, not just my own.
item_text.P2: I find it easy to respond to others as God does - with kindness and compassion.
item_text.P3: I am fully aware that I am partnering with God in my interactions with people.
item_text.P4: I ask the Holy Spirit to reveal God's presence to people with whom I am praying or interacting.
item_text.P5: I encourage other followers of Jesus to believe and have confidence in God's active presence in their lives.
item_text.P6: I regularly invite God's leadership to be expressed in my life.
item_text.P7: In situations of need that I see or hear, I act boldly upon what I believe God desires to do.
item_text.P8: I see God actively forming me to be a gift of love and grace to others.
item_text.P9: When I reach out to people in need, I have confidence that God will give me grace to help them toward healing, deliverance, and change.
item_text.C1: I am very aware of the active presence of God in all aspects of my life.
item_text.C2: When I notice that I am moving away from God, I quickly turn toward God to be restored.
item_text.C3: I expect God's Holy Spirit to guide me and give me the power to live my life God's way.
item_text.C4: I faithfully set aside personal time to read from or listen to the Bible.
item_text.C5: I read, listen, or view the writings and/or media of other Christians for help in understanding God better.
item_text.C6: I take time to regularly express praise for who God is in my life.
item_text.C7: I spend time every day speaking with God and seeking God's thoughts and direction.
item_text.C8: To support God's grace working in my life, I engage in spiritual practices such as fasting, meditation, or silence, etc.
item_text.C9: I ask God for wisdom in how to use the resources God has given me (time, energy and money).
item_text.T1: I know there is nothing I can do to make God love me more or love me less.
item_text.T2: The way I see myself is determined most of all by how I believe God sees me.
item_text.T3: Others see my love for God in how I express my love for them.
item_text.T4: The things I do for God I do for the joy of serving, not as a duty or obligation.
item_text.T5: Even in hard or difficult times, I am able to experience a deep sense of peace, trusting that God is with me.
item_text.T6: When I face challenging situations, I first seek to know how God would want me to respond.
item_text.T7: I am a person who regularly gives thanks to God for acting in my life.
item_text.T8: When I notice I have thoughts, motivations, words and actions that are displeasing to God, I am quick to confess them.
item_text.T9: I trust in and am committed to God's purposes for my life.
